thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: The key idea is to use dynamic programming to find the length of the longest common subsequence (LCS) between two strings. We create a 2D dp array where dp[i][j] represents the length of the LCS between the first i characters of text1 and the first j characters of text2.
